messages:
maya: Heads up — two PMs just hit a race when saving views. They clicked Save at the same time and one of them lost their name/ownership and we ended up with duplicate slugs in the UI. Repro steps below.

alex: Repro steps? can you paste short steps pls

maya: 1) open same route analytics 2) both click Save view within ~1s 3) if names identical we sometimes end up with one savedview (owner wrong) or two savedviews with identical slugs -> UI shows dup. Observed on prod-nightly.

jordan: Saw this on canary yesterday too. Smells like optimistic UI + backend unique index race. :thinking_face:

carla: Backend behavior: POST /api/savedviews {route_id,name,filters,owner_id} -> 201 or 409 on slug conflict. Frontend currently treats anything non-error-ish as success and swallows 409s in some flows.

sam: Do we have telemetry for 409s from savedviews.create?

sre-bot: Searches: 3 occurrences of 409 from savedviews.create between 2026-03-18T02:00Z and 2026-03-18T03:00Z. Top caller: console v2.12.

alex: Proposal: introduce optimistic locking + conflict modal. Backend returns an explicit optimistic-lock error (412) when etag mismatch; 409 stays for unique-slug. Frontend will catch 409/412 and show modal offering Rename / Merge / Keep Mine / Keep Theirs. Merge would union filters and maintain metadata.

maya: Leaning to a lightweight UX: when conflict detected show tiny modal suggesting a new name (name + " (1)") and a single "Merge filters" checkbox (off by default). Don't want to add too many clicks for PLG flows.

jordan: We need telemetry: count conflicts, modal shown, actions taken. Metric like `saveview_conflict` tagged by route_id/model_id and action.

carla: Implementation idea: support `If-Match: <etag>` header and return 412 if etag mismatch. Keep 409 for slug uniqueness. Also add Idempotency-Key header support for clients.

sam: Note: many automation scripts hit API directly. If we add strict locking we must support idempotent retry semantics or we will break CI/infra.

alex: Frontend pseudo: try POST, on 409 -> create new slug suggestion flow, on 412 -> open conflict modal with merge/rename. Example header usage: `POST /api/savedviews` 
Headers: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` `If-Match: W/"12345"`

maya: Rollout plan: behind feature-flag modal; enable on canary for 2 weeks, collect telemetry, then grad roll to prod. If saves drop significantly revert.

jordan: QA: add e2e test that fires concurrent POSTs (n=2) and verifies deterministic result (modal or renaming path) and no data loss.

carla: I'll own the backend PR. @maya can you draft modal copy and small UX sketch?

maya: Draft copy: "Conflict saving view — someone else saved a view with the same name. Choose to rename, merge filters, or keep your version." Buttons: [Rename] [Merge & Save] [Keep Mine] [Cancel]. Keep copy minimal.

sam: I'll add telemetry pings: `saveview_conflict_shown`, `saveview_conflict_action` with labels action=(rename|merge|keep_mine|keep_theirs) and route_id. Also log backend 409/412 rates for alerting.

alex: Docs: update API contract to document 409 vs 412 behaviors and headers. Add example curl.

sre-bot: FYI deploy window tonight 02:00-04:00Z. Feature flag will be OFF by default for prod.

maya: Thanks — can we sync tomorrow 10:00am PT for a quick unblock? need timeline for PRs & tests.

jordan: 10:00am PT works for me.

(attachments: small trace of two save requests showing duplicate slug + DB unique index violation, screenshot of console dup savedviews)
